videos.title: Priti Panwar & Sushma Mishra
videos.overview:
The most dashing Man of India, Megastar Amitabh Bachchan begins the most awaited show 'Saptakoti Mahadhari' Kaun Banega Crorepati on a musical note with Playback Singer Sonu Nigam. Priti Panwar becomes the first contestant to play KBC.  An introductory clip of Priti Panwar from Rohtak, Haryana depicts on the screen in which she expresses her views on Girls Education. Amitabh Bachchan welcomes Sanmeet Kaur Sahani. Priti Panwar becomes the first contestant to wins Rs. 25,00,000.

Megastar Amitabh Bachchan plays the Best of 3 with the top 9 Contestants. Sushma Mishra, a housewife from Raipur, Chhattisgarh becomes the second contestant to play Kaun Banega Crorepati. Amitabh Bachchan asks jackpot question to Sardar Kuldeep Singh.

videos.title: Sushma Mishra, Hussain Moiz Soni, & Rajni Rajpoot
videos.overview: Sushma Mishra, a housewife from Raipur, Chhatisgarh, continues playing also Young Hussain Moiz Soni, a B.Com Student from Jamnagar, Gujrat, joins Superstar Amitabh Bachchan on the hot-seat. He is accompanied by several members of his family in the audience and at towards the end of the show After several attempts at Fastest Finger First, an emotional Rajni Rajpoot finally makes it to the Hot-seat. Watch to see who wins what...

Later on Amitabh Bachchan plays the Best of 3 with the top 6 Contestants and the swiftest among them to reach on the Hot Seat is Neelkamal Singh. videos.overview:

Amitabh Bachchan plays the Best of 3 with the top 9 Contestants and Jyoti Saini from Hansi, Hisar (Haryana) joins Megastar Amitabh Bachchan on the Hot Seat. How much will she win?

What will his prize amount be? Watch to find out!
